metadata.title: feat(api): expand /health API to include database and Redis status
metadata.author: PawelK2012

description: ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes # https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/3817 --- ## 📝 Summary Goal: The /health API currently provides a basic health signal by validating Postgres connectivity and returning a generic healthy response. To improve observability and support more granular health monitoring, the endpoint should be expanded to include explicit status checks for additional infrastructure dependencies. This change will enhance the /health response to report the health of both Postgres and Redis, while continuing to expose a clear overall service health indicator ### Service healthy Response headers with _apply_runtime_mode_headers(response: Response) ### Redis is not configured ### Redis configured but unhealthy ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [ ] Bug fix - [x] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | | | Unit tests | `make test` | | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | | --- ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [x] Tests added/updated for changes - [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable) - [x] No secrets or credentials committed --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) _Screenshots, design decisions, or additional context._

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body:
Misspelling on "Databse" in message string.
```suggestion
        status_items.append(HealthStatusItem(name="Database", statusCode=status.HTTP_200_OK, message="Database Connection Successful"))
```

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body:
Misspelling on "Databse" in message string.
```suggestion
        status_items.append(HealthStatusItem(name="Database", statusCode=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, message="Cannot connect to Database"))
```

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body: Docstring should state that this is Async now.

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body: "statusCode" should be python style snake_case/train_case instead of CamelCase (and subsequent changes down stream as well.

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body: "statusItems" should be python style snake_case/train_case instead of CamelCase (and subsequent changes down stream as well.

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body: Please use "Cache" instead of "Redis" through the PR, insofar as possible the health check should not expose the stack or limit any future changes to implementation/deployment details e.g. if someone was implement an alternative caching solution interface later on.

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body: Please use "Cache" instead of "Redis" in these strings. We don't want to expose parts of the stack choice or deployment choices unnecessarily in "name"s or in "message"

comments.author: brian-hussey
comments.body:
This logic is duplicated on line 10175:
```
if settings.cache_type == "redis" and settings.redis_url:
```
I'd say move the redis_enabled = [...] to above the if statement, and use `if redis_enabled:` for that logical check and then again in the redis_healthy line.

comments.author: PawelK2012
comments.body: @brian-hussey do you mean it's a duplicate of `if settings.cache_type == "redis" and settings.redis_url is not None:` on [L235](https://github.com/PawelK2012/mcp-context-forge/blob/e064ccad0b0963eeb643c1235a0f6a0d32b4a00f/mcpgateway/main.py#L235)  ?

comments.author: PawelK2012
comments.body: @brian-hussey sorry I see what you mean now.

reviews.author: brian-hussey
reviews.body:
Hey @PawelK2012 thank you for the submission. A few minor changes requested for security, maintainability point of view.

Overall very good PR, with test coverage, clear separation of concerns between the cache details and database details and the solution maintains backward compatibility with existing health check behaviour.

If you can address the requested changes that would be great, but if you can't please let me know and I'll get them taken care of in order to get this one merged in.

Thanks, Brian

reviews.author: brian-hussey
reviews.body: @PawelK2012 Thanks for correcting based on all the feedback. This is looking good now, I'll add it to our merge queue now and get it merged in shortly.
